name: What factors influence the total cost of finishing basement drywall?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the total cost of finishing basement drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement drywall costs depend on total square footage, ceiling height, framing layout, and the complexity of architectural features. Straight perimeter walls require less labor than basements with multiple partitioned rooms, closets, soffits, and stairwells. Wrapping steel support posts, boxing out low-hanging HVAC ductwork, and finishing window wells also increase cutting and taping labor. Choosing higher-grade moisture-resistant sheetrock or requesting smooth Level 5 drywall finishes instead of standard textured finishes will also adjust total project costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on total square footage, ceiling height, architectural framing details like duct soffits and post wraps, board type, and desired finish texture.
